items.title: Finiteness of the cohomology of a constructible sheaf on a curve is unchanged by replacing it by its extension by zero from a dense open
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a Noetherian ring Lambda, an algebraically closed field k, a separated finite type scheme X over k of dimension at most one, a constructible sheaf F of Lambda-modules on X_etale and the inclusion j : X' -> X of a dense open, the cohomology H^q(X, F) is a finite Lambda-module exactly when H^q(X, j_!j^{-1}F) is (statement lines 15926-15934). The proof (proof lines 15936-15970) identifies the complement as a finite set of rational points, computes the cohomology of the sheaf supported there through the Leray spectral sequence for the finite closed immersion, and reads the equivalence off the long exact sequence. H2: one exact sequence computation with two inputs, written out in full.
